name: todd-graves
description: Todd Graves, founder of Raising Cane's, as a Claude Code playbook. Radical focus on a single offering, refusing dilution, retaining ownership and control, and letting service drive growth. Turns an expansion or fundraising temptation into a focus and control plan: the one thing in a sentence, the details worth perfecting, the refusal list, the unit metric to attack, and the ownership audit that keeps the company yours.
